test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was selected for 'Guru Gopinath Desiya Natya Puraskaram, 2019' by the State Government of Kerala for popularising Sattriya - the Indian classical dance form of Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira P P Bora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indira P P Bora** was selected for **'Guru Gopinath Desiya Natya Puraskaram, 2019' **by the State Government of Kerala for popularising** Sattriya - the Indian classical dance form of Assam.**
 
• Indira P.P. Bora, a Sattriya dancer, has been chosen to receive the Guru Gopinath Desiya Natya Puraskaram, 2019, the State government's highest honour given annually for excellence in dance.
 
• The Guru Gopinath Natana Gramam established the prize for the Culture Department.
 
• A notable form of Indian classical dance is sattriya. The scholar and saint Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev, a member of the Bhakti movement, is credited with creating this dance-drama performance art, which has its roots in the Assamese Vaishnavism monasteries that are centred on Krishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **With Sattriya dance, Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan** is known. Tankeswar has been chosen for the 2018 Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards (Akademi Puraskar).
 
• **Guru Ramkrishna Talukdar** is the first Assamese individual to receive an "A" grade accreditation from Doordarshan Delhi in Sattriya.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award nominee for 2016 is Assamese Sattriya dancer **Haricharan Bhuyan Borbayan.**
